name: Creeping Shadow
body:
School conjuration (creation) [darkness]; Level antipaladin 4, legendary ninja 4, occultist 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a whisker from a black cat and a bottle of smoke trapped on a moonless night)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Area one 20-ft. cube per level (S)
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You create an amorphous cloud of tangible, inky blackness that completely blocks normal vision and darkvision, as deeper darkness. In addition, the creeping shadow swallows all sound within it, muffling speech and affecting the entire area as silence. As a move action, you can move the cloud up to 20 feet in any direction. You can reshape the cloud as The creeping shadow has physical substance and can be dispersed rapidly by wind effects. Each round of light wind (11+ miles per hour) expends 2 rounds of the remaining duration of the creeping shadow, while a strong wind (51+ miles per hour) disperses it in a single round.
